site.name: A99 Highway Widening, Greenfield
site.description: Agricultural chalk downland site on a 200×60m linear corridor proposed for highway widening. Terrain rises gently northward. Vegetation consists of arable crops with field hedgerows along corridor edges.
site.constraints: Topsoil not deeper than 0.5m. Weathered chalk variable. Chalk is reliable founding stratum below 4m.

geological_units.name: Topsoil
geological_units.description: Dark brown silty clay topsoil with rootlets and organic matter. Agricultural horizon, plough-disturbed in upper 0.3m.

geological_units.name: Weathered Chalk
geological_units.description: Buff to pale grey structureless putty chalk with occasional flint fragments. Frost-shattered and weathered. SPT N typically 10–30.

geological_units.name: Chalk
geological_units.description: White to off-white moderately strong chalk, Grade III–IV. Occasional flint bands and thin marl partings. SPT N typically 30–60+. Reliable founding stratum.
